headline: Application role granted access to all S3 buckets in the account instead of just specific data buckets

findings.evidence_ref: default changed from specific ARNs (`acme-prod-data`) to `["*"]` in variables.tf
findings.explanation: The application role will now have read/write access to every S3 bucket in the AWS account, including logging, billing, backups, and other applications' data. This violates the principle of least privilege and creates a severe security risk if the application or its credentials are compromised.
